title: Landscaping Estimate Template: Fill In, Download PDF, Word, Excel
description: Price sod, mulch, patios and lawn care in your browser. No sign-up. An estimate with scope, exclusions and deposit, plus US ranges and state rules, with sources.
lede_html: Write a landscaping or lawn care estimate in this form, then save it as a PDF, Word or Excel file. No account needed. The sample is a front-yard redo. Enter your own yard.

sample.scope: Strip old lawn in front yard, 1,200 sq ft. Grade, lay St. Augustine sod, add 4 yd of mulch to beds, trim 2 oaks. Haul away debris.
sample.exclusions: Irrigation repair, tree removal, gas or utility line relocation.
sample.terms: Plant material warranty: 30 days with watering as advised. Call 811 before digging.

must_show.heading: What a landscaping estimate should say
must_show.intro_html: A landscaping estimate states the area, the materials by name, what you haul away and whether the plants carry a warranty. The customer can then match bids.
must_show.why_label: Why it matters in a yard
rows: Square feet or cubic yards let the customer compare two bids.
Sod type, mulch type and size of each plant.
Grading, stripping and soil are often the largest hidden cost.
Say if debris leaves the site.
A plant warranty usually depends on watering. Say what you expect.
Texas taxes landscaping labor, so state the tax line where your state asks for it.

example.heading: Filled example: 12-visit mowing season
example.intro_html: A recurring job at sample prices.
example.after_html: The range for mowing is $42–$68 from LawnStarter.

line_items.heading: Landscaping line items and typical prices
line_items.intro_html: Tap Add to put a line on the form. The range comes from the source in the same row. The price that the button adds is a sample inside that range, not a price recommendation.

items.name: Landscaping labor up to landscape architect

rules.heading: Rules to check before you send a landscaping estimate

items.title: Texas sales tax
items.html: Texas lists planting, mowing, trimming and edging grass, and tree care, as taxable. Add state and local rate, unless you work alone with yearly receipts of $5,000 or less.

items.title: Pesticide license in Texas
items.html: A person who applies any pesticide to ornamental plants, trees, lawns or weeds for hire needs a Texas Department of Agriculture license. A person who applies only fertilizer does not.

items.title: California C-27 class
items.html: The C-27 landscape contractor constructs, maintains, repairs and installs landscape systems and facilities. Print the number on the estimate when you hold it.

faq.q: Should I price a mowing contract as one estimate?
faq.a: Yes. Enter visits as the quantity and the visit price as the unit price. The total shows the full season.

faq.q: How do I handle soil that is worse than expected?
faq.a: Exclude it, or give a unit price per cubic yard for added soil. Then you can bill it without a dispute.

faq.q: Do I need a separate line for delivery?
faq.a: Add one when the material price does not include it. Bulk delivery costs differ by distance.

faq.q: Can I ask for a deposit on a landscape job?
faq.a: Enter the percent on the form. Check the rule of your state first.
